result.summary: The page is mostly functional and well-structured. One minor visual issue was identified related to a discount badge displaying potentially incorrect or placeholder text.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card displays '-0%', which is a nonsensical discount value. It likely indicates a data error or a fallback when no discount is available.
issues.suggestion: If no discount applies, hide the badge entirely rather than showing '-0%'. Ensure the discount value logic accounts for zero or null values and suppresses the badge accordingly.
